description:
Job Title: Appian Case Management Studio Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
* * * 
 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 The Appian Case Management Studio Developer designs, builds, and maintains Appian-based case management and workflow applications to streamline mission and business processes within a federal environment.  This role focuses on leveraging Appian Case Management Studio to configure dynamic records, process models, and data fabric structures that manage complex case lifecycles—while enabling secure integrations with backend systems such as SAP ECC to provide end-to-end process visibility and automation. The developer works within an Agile framework, collaborating closely with Federal stakeholders, system integrators, and SAP technical teams to deliver compliant, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.
 
 CACI supports a contract with a large Federal civilian customer to develop, maintain, and modernize business critical Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) systems built on SAP technology. The Appian Case Management Studio Developer will be part of an integrated project to team to support a project to lead and develop an Appian application that will interface with the existing COTS solution.  We are looking for an experienced Case Management Studio Developer who can effectively communicate with team members and develop solutions to address business requirements using the Appian case management toolset.
 
 Responsibilites: 
 Lead architecture and design of case management applications and ensure best practices in low-code development, integrations and data modeling.
 Design and implement Appian Case Management applications using Case Management Studio, including Records, Actions, Process Models, and User Interfaces.
 Configure case hierarchies, record relationships, task routing, and reporting dashboards tailored to Federal workflows.
 Integrate Appian workflows with SAP ECC systems using REST/OData services, Appian Integration Designer, and Connected Systems to synchronize data (e.g., purchase orders, requisitions, funds, and vendor data).
 Build low-code automation components, such as Web APIs, RPA bots, and process event triggers, to improve efficiency and data accuracy.
 Collaborate with SAP, database, and middleware teams to define secure data exchange standards and field mappings.
 Ensure all integrations and applications adhere to FedRAMP, FISMA, and agency ATO requirements, including identity management (SAML/OAuth), encryption, and audit logging.
 Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews; estimate work effort and contribute to continuous improvement.
 Develop and maintain technical documentation, design artifacts, and configuration guides compliant with Federal CDRL and IV&V expectations.
 Support production deployments, performance tuning, and troubleshooting in collaboration with DevSecOps teams.
 Leverage Appian Reports and Process Analytics to provide data-driven insight into operational performance.
 
 Qualifications: 
 
 Required: 
 Under this contract any male born after 12/31/1959 must be registered and certify their registration with the Selective Service System or have a waiver from the Selective Service Systems as a condition of employment. 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
 7+ years of Appian application development experience, including at least 1+ year with Appian Case Management Studio.
 Hands-on experience developing process models, records, interfaces, and decision rules in Appian.
 Working knowledge of Appian Data Fabric and Record-to-Record relationships for complex case architectures.
 Experience integrating Appian with enterprise systems via REST APIs, OData, or web services (preferably SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA).
 Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative tools such as Jira and Confluence.
 Familiarity with Federal IT compliance frameworks (FedRAMP Moderate, FISMA, NIST 800-53).
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong written and oral communication abilities.
 
 Desired: 
 Appian Certified Associate or Senior Developer credential.
 Experience with Appian Case Management Studio advanced features (Task Reports, Smart Services, and Record Actions).
 Exposure to SAP BTP or SAP Gateway for integration design and testing.
 Familiarity with Appian RPA, Appian AI Copilot, or Appian Process Mining.
 Experience developing or supporting Appian applications in a FedRAMP-authorized Appian Government Cloud environment.
 Basic understanding of ABAP data structures or SAP ECC business objects related to Finance, Procurement, or Logistics.
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300-$189,600 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
